description: Grew up in the wilds, far from civilization and the comforts of town and technology.

properties.name: Outlander
properties.description: You grew up in the wilds, far from civilization and the comforts of town and technology. You've witnessed the migration of herds larger than forests, survived weather more extreme than any city-dweller can comprehend.
equipment: A trophy from an animal you killed

feature.name: Wanderer
feature.description: You have an excellent memory for maps and geography, and you can always recall the general layout of terrain, settlements, and other features around you. In addition, you can find fresh water and food for yourself and up to five other people each day, provided that the land offers berries, small game, water, etc.

personality_traits: I'm always picking things up, absently fiddling with them, and sometimes accidentally breaking them.
I feel far more comfortable among the ancient trees and wild beasts than in bustling cities.
ideals: Nature: The natural world is more important than the constructs of civilization.
bonds: An injury to the unspoiled wilderness of my home is an injury to me.
flaws: I am slow to trust others and prefer solitude even in times of danger.
